# Printomation

> B2B SaaS Automation Platform for Amazon Custom Sellers

Printomation is the B2B SaaS platform for Amazon sellers offering personalised products. Our software automates the conversion of Amazon Custom orders and buyer personalisation data into ready-to-use print and laser engraving files (SVG, PDF, DXF, EZCad) — saving hours of manual work and eliminating costly errors.

## Key Features
- Official Amazon Selling Partner SP-API Integration
- Automated Buyer Customization Data Ingestion (Text, Photos, Options)
- ASIN Template Rules, Layout Bounds & Vector Pre-Flight
- Machine-Ready Multi-Format Export (SVG, PDF, DXF, EZCad)
- Zero Manual Retyping & Automated Error Prevention
